messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1778889999 - GPU pool 'hotpath-eu-west' queue depth > 95% for 3m, sustained 429s observed

sara (SRE-oncall): paging in. seeing user-facing 429s reported by the dashboard and a spike in request_rejects. starting triage. any recent deploys?

miguel (infra): no deploys on that pool. autoscaler logs show failed scale attempts starting ~1778889200 due to lock contention on allocation-manager.

jia (runtime): stack traces look like tokenbucket refills not applied for tier 'standard' — token window pegged at 0. causing immediate rejects when queue builds. might be race with policy swap earlier.

sara (SRE-oncall): ok — two simultaneous problems: autoscaler failing to add capacity + tokenbucket misconfig for standard tier -> mass 429s. impact: many PLG customers degraded, some enterprise routes degraded but fallback to dedicated pools for a few key accounts.

claire (sre-lead): @sara start mitigation runbook: 1) reduce ingress for standard tier (soft 429 to degrade gracefully) 2) force-scale a new ephemeral hotpath pool 3) patch tokenbucket refill thread. assign owners.

sara (SRE-oncall): steps: 1) miguel to force scale pool, 2) jia to patch token refill, 3) ravi to adjust tier routing to divert heavy customers to spare pool, 4) priya to notify impacted customers. I'll coordinate.

miguel (infra): scaling up now — running: 
```
./scale-pool --region eu-west --pool hotpath-eu-west --target-gpus 12 --force
```

deploy-bot: scaling job started (job id: scale-1778889321). estimated spin-up 2m.

ops-bot: note: autoscaler heartbeat shows allocation-manager lock contention: last_lock_time=1778889255, pending_ops=18.

jia (runtime): investigating tokenbucket service. quick fix: increase refill window and disable refill coalescing. applying quick patch to runtime service now.

sara (SRE-oncall): priya, customers?

priya (customer-success): already flagged top 10 affected accounts. sending initial status: "We're aware of an outage affecting inference requests in EU region; our engineers are mitigating. We'll follow up with ETA when traffic stabilizes." Will escalate any paying customer with SLA risk.

miguel (infra): new pool instances booting. health checks failing initially due to kv-cache mismatch. doing rolling kv-sync from primary.

jia (runtime): quick patch applied to tokenbucket service and restarted on 2/3 hotpath nodes: 
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/tokenbucket --namespace inference-eu
```

sara (SRE-oncall): traffic shaping: reducing rate caps for `standard` tier from 250rps -> 120rps via runtime feature flag to reduce rejects while scale completes.

ops-bot: feature flag applied: runtime.ratecap.standard=120 (propagated in 45s).

sara (SRE-oncall): checking metrics: queue depth dropping from 98% -> 60% after ratecap. 429s tail latency dropping but still occuring for some requests.

ravi (capacity): allocation-manager lock cleared after scale job; manual resync of token assignments done. Looks like a bug where tier-swap attempted to reassign tokens while pool resize held the same lock -> deadlock. I'll open a follow-on ticket to change lock ordering.

claire (sre-lead): good call. immediate postmortem items: (A) fix lock ordering in allocation-manager (B) add circuit-breaker so tokenbucket refill can't be paused by resize (C) improve runbook steps for rapid tier-diversion.

miguel (infra): new pool healthy. backend metrics: hotpath-eu-west capacity +12 GPUs ready. starting traffic shift to new pool.

deploy-bot: traffic routing change applied: route 18% -> new-pool (deploy id: route-1778889400).

sara (SRE-oncall): observe for 10m then start rollback of ratecap if stable.

priya (customer-success): sent update to affected customers: approx ETA 10-15m, will follow with apology and summary of mitigation.

jia (runtime): tokenbucket service patch verified. refill intervals normal and token supply recovered. logs: 
```
INFO tokenbucket refill complete for tier=standard, tokens_added=1.2e6, time=1778889457
```

sara (SRE-oncall): metrics at 1778889800: error 429 rate down 81%, p95 latency improved. queue depth steady ~18%.

claire (sre-lead): begin severity de-escalation prep. please capture timestamps for postmortem. who took the autoscale force step?

miguel (infra): I ran the force-scale command at 1778889330.

ravi (capacity): I performed manual tier-diversion at 1778889412 to route heavy customers to spare pool.

jia (runtime): I patched tokenbucket at 1778889426 and restarted pods.

sara (SRE-oncall): handing off to night oncall. i'll create a short incident summary and open a postmortem ticket. handing off to @alex (oncall-night) in 10m.

alex (oncall-night): acknowledged. I'll monitor for 1h and verify no recurrence.

claire (sre-lead): action items assigned:
- MIGUEL: formalize a safe force-scale play with pre-checks (ticket INF-2301)
- JIA: unit + e2e tests for tokenbucket refill race (INF-2302)
- RAVI: lock-ordering fix + add metrics around allocation-manager locks (INF-2303)
- SARA: postmortem writeup + customer impact timeline (INF-2304)

priya (customer-success): flagged top impacted accounts for postmortem inclusion. will attach CS outreach logs.

sara (SRE-oncall): closing loop: incident is mitigated. customers seeing normal behavior gradually. marking as handoff->monitoring. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED 1778893600 - root cause: allocation-manager lock ordering + tokenbucket refill race during pool resize; mitigation: forced pool scale, tokenbucket patch, tier diversion. follow-up tickets created.

claire (sre-lead): thanks team. postmortem owner: sara. please include timelines and the command snippets used.

priya (customer-success): sending final customer update and credits plan to PM/finance.

sara (SRE-oncall): logging handoff note for alex: monitor allocation-manager metrics, watch tokenbucket refill success rates, and confirm p99 latency remains stable.

alex (oncall-night): on it.
